title: Design System: Scratchpad — Indigo on Paper v5

chrome.purpose: System sans owns the chrome: rail, note index rows, controls, and dialog bodies.

prose.purpose: The editorial serif carries the display voice: the document title, the list date heading, the date-spine numeral, and rendered prose headings.

metadata.purpose: Monospace is reserved for compact metadata and keyboard hints — it is Scratchpad's second signature alongside indigo.

shadows.name: shadow-card
shadows.purpose: The document card is the sole raised surface in the shell.

shadows.name: shadow-row-active
shadows.purpose: Restrained elevation on the selected note row.

motion.name: ease-pop
motion.purpose: Task checkbox feedback and existing entrances.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single most important action in a context. Pill geometry with a colored indigo glow.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; height: 40px; padding: 0 18px; font-family: var(--sans); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; border-radius: var(--r-pill); border: 1px solid transparent; cursor: pointer; transition: background var(--t-fast) ease, border-color var(--t-fast) ease, color var(--t-fast) ease, box-shadow var(--t-fast) ease, transform var(--t-fast) var(--press); } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--accent); color: var(--on-accent); box-shadow: var(--shadow-primary); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-d); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A tinted pill rather than an outlined one — control-fill at 5% ink, no border.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; height: 40px; padding: 0 18px; font-family: var(--sans); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; border-radius: var(--r-pill); border: 1px solid transparent; cursor: pointer; transition: background var(--t-fast) ease, color var(--t-fast) ease, transform var(--t-fast) var(--press); } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary { background: var(--control-fill); color: var(--ink); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--control-fill-hover); }

components.name: Search Control
components.description: Local note search and command entry in the note index header.
components.html: ⌘K
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-width: 0; height: 38px; padding: 0 10px; background: var(--field-bg); border: 1px solid var(--hairline-color-2); border-radius: var(--r-md); box-shadow: var(--field-inset-shadow); transition: border-color var(--t-fast) ease, box-shadow var(--t-fast) ease; } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-focus-ring); } .ds-search-icon { flex: none; color: var(--text-muted); } .ds-search-input { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; height: 100%; border: 0; background: transparent; outline: none; padding: 0; font: 400 13.5px/1 var(--sans); color: var(--ink); } .ds-search-input::placeholder { color: var(--text-muted); } .ds-search-hint { flex: none; font: 500 11px/1 var(--sans); color: var(--text-muted); background: var(--control-fill); border-radius: var(--r-code); padding: 3px 6px; }

components.name: Note Row — Selected
components.description: Selected note row in the Indigo on Paper index. Warm paper, hairline border, compact title and metadata.
components.css: .ds-note-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; column-gap: 10px; row-gap: 3px; width: 100%; text-align: left; background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--r-lg); padding: 10px 12px; cursor: pointer; color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--sans); position: relative; transition: background var(--t-fast) ease, border-color var(--t-fast) ease, box-shadow var(--t-fast) ease; } .ds-note-row:hover { background: var(--row-hover); } .ds-note-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-note-row.ds-is-active { background: var(--paper); border-color: var(--hairline-color); box-shadow: var(--shadow-row-active); padding-left: 14px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-note-row.ds-is-active::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 8px; bottom: 8px; width: 2.5px; border-radius: var(--r-pill); background: var(--accent); } .ds-note-title { font: 700 13.5px/1.35 var(--sans); color: var(--ink); } .ds-note-when { font: 400 11.5px/1.35 var(--mono); color: var(--text-muted); } .ds-note-excerpt { grid-column: 1 / -1; font: 400 11.3px/1.43 var(--sans); color: var(--text-secondary); display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; overflow: hidden; } @media (min-width: 900px) { .ds-note-row.ds-is-active::before { content: none; } }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: The privacy guarantee made visible. Carries backup state via data-backup-state: healthy (meadow), aging (amber), missing (rust, weight 600).
components.css: .ds-status-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; height: 26px; padding: 0 11px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--r-pill); background: var(--control-fill); font: 500 11px/1 var(--sans); color: var(--text-secondary); cursor: pointer; } .ds-status-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-status-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: var(--r-pill); background: var(--success); flex: none; } .ds-status-chip[data-backup-state="healthy"] { background: var(--success-tint); color: var(--success-text); } .ds-status-chip[data-backup-state="aging"] { background: var(--warning-tint); color: var(--warning-dark); } .ds-status-chip[data-backup-state="aging"] .ds-status-dot { background: var(--warning); } .ds-status-chip[data-backup-state="missing"] { background: var(--rust-tint); color: var(--rust); font-weight: 600; } .ds-status-chip[data-backup-state="missing"] .ds-status-dot { background: var(--rust); }

components.name: Tag Badge
components.description: A tag is a filter button plus an optional remove control. Accent-soft fill, accent text, pill radius.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 22px; border-radius: var(--r-pill); background: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--accent); font: 500 12px/1 var(--sans); overflow: hidden; transition: background var(--t-fast) ease; } .ds-tag:hover { background: var(--accent-soft-2); } .ds-tag-filter { border: 0; background: transparent; color: inherit; font: inherit; padding: 0 4px 0 9px; height: 100%; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tag-remove { border: 0; background: transparent; color: inherit; font: 13px/1 var(--sans); padding: 0 8px 0 2px; height: 100%; cursor: pointer; opacity: 0.65; } .ds-tag-remove:hover { opacity: 1; } .ds-tag-filter:focus-visible, .ds-tag-remove:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Brand Glyph
components.description: A 26px gradient squircle at 9px radius with an indigo glow — one of the three sanctioned gradients in the system. Strokes stay white in both themes.
components.css: .ds-glyph { width: 26px; height: 26px; flex-shrink: 0; display: block; background: var(--accent-grad); border-radius: var(--r-glyph); box-shadow: var(--shadow-glyph); } .ds-glyph-lines { stroke: var(--glyph-ink); stroke-width: 2.4; stroke-linecap: round; fill: none; }

components.name: Writing Surface
components.description: The sole raised surface in the app shell. Serif title and readable prose on warm paper.
components.html:
Daily note

A quiet place to write, with room for the words.
components.css: .ds-document { background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); border-radius: var(--r-lg); box-shadow: var(--shadow-card); padding: 32px; } .ds-document-title { margin: 0 0 20px; font: 600 36px/1.15 var(--serif); letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-document-body { margin: 0; max-width: 620px; font: 400 16px/1.65 var(--serif); }

narrative.northStar: Scratchpad is a quiet private chronicle.
narrative.overview:
Scratchpad is a quiet private chronicle. The interface should make the current
day easy to find, the recent past easy to scan, and the open note feel like the
only thing that matters. It is calm without becoming anonymous: the vertical
date rail and the document date spine are its recognizable signature.

The design has three layers:

1. A narrow chronology rail for orientation and daily-note entry.
2. A compact note index for navigation and local-only trust cues.
3. A generous document stage with one raised paper writing surface.

The application remains local-only. Visual changes must never add remote fonts,
assets, analytics, or user-content requests.
keyCharacteristics: A narrow chronology rail for orientation and daily-note entry.
A compact note index for navigation and local-only trust cues.
A generous document stage with one raised paper writing surface.

rules.name: Color
rules.body:
Indigo is the only decorative accent. Use it for the selected date, primary
actions, links, tags, focus rings, the date spine, and the active daily-note
callout. Semantic success, warning, and danger colors are reserved for actual
state.

- Canvas: `#ECE7DC`
- Paper: `#FFFFFF`
- Ink: `#211E1A`
- Secondary text: `#55504A`
- Muted text: `#797368`
- Indigo: `#5661B3`
- Indigo hover: `#414B91`
- Indigo tint: `#E8E9F4`
- Indigo pressed/strong tint: `#DBDDF1`

All application CSS colors route through tokens in
`public/css/inkwell-tokens.css`. Do not put literal color values in
`public/css/app.css`.

Dark mode is a token flip, not a separate composition. Keep auto-dark and the
explicit `[data-theme="dark"]` token blocks synchronized and verify contrast on
the opaque active note row, the tinted daily-note card, and primary controls.

rules.name: Surfaces and depth
rules.body:
The Chronicle shell is opaque and architectural:

- The date rail is the quietest surface.
- The note index is a slightly brighter adjacent plane.
- The main area is a warm sunken document stage.
- The document card is the sole raised surface in the shell.

Do not add blur or gradients to the app shell. Use one-pixel separators and
restrained existing elevation on the document. Dialogs and static pages may
continue using legacy glass tokens until they receive their own redesign.

rules.name: Typography
rules.body:
Use platform fonts only.

- The editorial serif carries the display voice: the document title, the list
  date heading, the date-spine numeral, and rendered prose headings.
- System sans owns the chrome: rail, note index rows, controls, and dialog
  bodies. Dialog titles take the serif (see Dialogs).
- Monospace is reserved for compact metadata and keyboard hints — it is
  Scratchpad's second signature alongside indigo.

Desktop document titles should be substantial but not promotional: serif at
weight 600, 36px rising to about 44px at the wide breakpoint, with gentle
tracking. Body prose stays readable at a maximum measure of 620px.
